In addition to continued $50 price drops on AirPods Pro 3, 9to5Toys' deals this afternoon also include $184 off the 46mm titanium Apple Watch Series 11, $130 off the aluminum cellular model, and more starting from $299. Rare Apple keyboard and black Magic Mouse deals are somehow still live, and we also have a discount on my personal favorite Anker Prime power bank that doubles as a wall charger, but today's real accessories highlight is Nomad's massive anniversary sitewide sale featuring rare discounts on MagSafe chargers, cases, Find My tracking cards, Watch bands, and much more. More below.

Take advantage of summer pricing to grab AirPods Pro 3 now marked down nearly $50, with more models starting from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (originally $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 ANC $149 (originally $179)

Back in stock: 46mm titanium Apple Watch Series 11 discounted $184 at Amazon

This deal sold out quickly yesterday, so act fast today if you're interested. The 46mm titanium GPS + Cellular Apple Watch Series 11 is once again discounted $184 at Amazon.

Amazon now has the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular with Slate titanium case and Black Sport Band shipping for as low as $564.97.

This is one of the higher-end titanium case models, priced at $749. Today's likely flash deal saves you $184, making it one of the best prices we've seen on this configuration. It briefly dipped to $550 before Prime Day last month, but otherwise this is the lowest price we've tracked for this spec.

To reiterate, this deal is only for those who want the Slate titanium case — even with the discount, you're still paying a premium. However, the more popular aluminum Series 11 models also have $100 and $130 markdowns this week:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular from $399 (originally $499)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular from $399 (originally $529)

Rare Apple keyboard and black Magic Mouse deals are somehow still live, with all-time lows starting from $80

We of course see plenty of deals on Apple flagships — $50 off AirPods Pro 3, up to $130 off the most popular Apple Watch Series 11 models — but discounts on Magic accessories are far less common. However, Prime Day pricing on the basic Magic Keyboard, the full-size model with Touch ID, and the black Apple Magic Mouse is somehow continuing.

Before these extended Prime Day deals, discounts on these Apple accessories have been very rare, and we can't predict how long they will last.

  • Black Apple Magic Mouse $80 (originally $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard $80 (originally $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID full-size $145 (originally $179)

All three are the all-time lowest prices we've tracked at Amazon. The black Apple Magic Mouse hasn't been discounted at this price in a long time (I want to grab another as a backup myself), and both Magic Keyboard models are also at record lows — the basic model has only hit this price once before today's discount, while the Touch ID model has never dropped below $158.

If you've been looking to upgrade your Apple Magic input gear, Prime Day pricing is still live, so don't miss out.

Nomad's massive anniversary sitewide sale now live: rare discounts on MagSafe chargers, cases, Watch bands, and much more

Rare 20% off! Nomad's beautiful metal and glass 25W Qi2 MagSafe charging stand

There are plenty of cheaper 25W Qi2 MagSafe stands available, but few match the beauty and quality of Nomad's latest model. Though the retail price is steep, with the brand's official 2026 anniversary sale now live, rare discounts on both the 2-in-1 and 3-in-1 models can charge your entire Apple mobile setup.

Nomad's 2026 anniversary sale is officially underway, with discounts on plenty of iPhone 17 cases, wallets, Apple Watch bands, and other charging accessories — the Stand One and Stand One Max being among the rarest deals:

  • Nomad 2-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One $103 (originally $129)
  • Nomad 3-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One Max $135 (originally $169)

These are Nomad's latest generation 25W Qi2 MagSafe stands, now selling at 20% off. The discount looks small, but these products almost never see any markdowns.

Crafted with premium solid metal construction that feels substantial, paired with a glass finish, providing an elegant and luxurious resting place for your Apple devices.

The only downside to this sale is that the newly released Cosmic Orange colorway is not included:

Rare deal! Nomad Tracking Card: Apple Find My Pro model, Cosmic Orange, Google Find Hub, and more

Nomad's anniversary sale is now officially live, and while the Tracking Card Pro and Air had a small misfire earlier, they are now properly in stock. The discounts aren't huge, but they're rare, with Apple Find My and Google Find Hub versions starting from $32.

The Nomad Tracking Card is one of the best in its class, featuring wireless MagSafe charging — I carry one with me everywhere:

  • Tracking Card Air $32 (originally $35) — Apple Find My or Google Find Hub versions
  • Tracking Card Pro $41 (originally $45) — all three colorways

Nomad Titanium Stratos Apple Watch band discounted 20% during anniversary sale (rare discount)

My personal favorite portable charger with a display that also doubles as a wall charger, the Anker Prime power bank drops to summer low of $70

Anker's 2026 summer sale continues with discounts on the latest Prime charging gear, power banks, desktop chargers, 25W MagSafe stands, and more. One of my favorite portable charging products has dropped back to its 2026 low of $69.99 — this 9,600mAh Anker Prime power bank that doubles as a wall charger.

The 9,600mAh Anker Prime power bank is now shipping at Amazon for $69.99. With a regular price up to $90 and this same discount appearing multiple times this year, we wanted to make sure you don't miss out this week — it's been the most useful portable charging device in my kit over the past year.

There are certainly more powerful, higher-capacity options with faster charging output in the brand's lineup, but this one is incredibly practical for me. As one of the smaller models, it slips easily into my everyday carry bag while still featuring a smart display, USB-C ports, and enough juice to keep my devices powered all day and beyond when I'm out.

Check out my full hands-on review.

It's also one of the few models in the lineup that can double as a wall charger. There are built-in foldable prongs on the back of the power bank, so you can charge the internal battery while also using it as a wall charger — I love this design, meaning I don't need to bring an extra device just to charge.

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • This 140W 4-port charger can power your entire setup today for $35 (41% off)
  • Grab this dual Qi charging mousepad for $30 to charge your iPhone and AirPods (originally $70)
  • The 250W Anker Prime charging station with LCD display can replace 6 chargers, now down to $95
  • Belkin 100W USB-C GaN wall charger drops to Amazon all-time low of $25.50
  • Satechi's latest ChargeView 140W desktop charger with display returns to Prime Day low of $80
  • Add 4 Matter-certified Edison smart bulbs to your Apple, Google, or Alexa smart home for under $8 each
  • Light up your home and add Matter support with Govee's 3-pack Permanent Outdoor Lights Prism from $430
  • Grab the DOCKCASE 2-in-1 USB-C SD card reader for just $7 today (47% off) for your tech bag
  • Rare deal: Belkin 25W UltraCharge Pro 3-in-1 MagSafe charging stand drops to Amazon all-time low
  • Still live: Anker's latest 45W Nano charger with smart display is just $26 today (all colorways)
  • UGREEN FineTrack Slim Find My wallet tracker with MagSafe charging is just $18 today
  • Grab this magnetic Apple Watch band for $20 (save 41%)
  • Anker 10-port flat plug surge protector power strip now down to $20 at Amazon

Still live: Anker's 3-port 160W Prime charger with smart display returns to Prime Day pricing (33% off), more from $8

In addition to ongoing discounts on Anker's Qi2 25W smart charger with display and the latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand, the 3-port 160W Prime charger with display has also returned to Prime Day pricing (33% off).

Amazon's official Anker storefront now has the 3-port Prime charger with smart display shipping for $99.99.

For what is essentially a wall charger, it's not the cheapest option, but it has a built-in smart display and is "about the same size as an AirPods Pro 3 case, easy to carry around, while still delivering up to 160W of charging power for all your devices."

More specifically, it can deliver up to 140W output through a single USB-C port, capable of "charging a 16-inch MacBook Pro from 0% to 50% in 25 minutes."

As for the smart display, it uses AnkerSense View technology to "monitor power output in real time on-screen, instantly switch modes, and unlock custom modes via Bluetooth through a dedicated app."
